purpose: Read-only AInvest macroeconomic JSON data, independent of visualization.

cli.group: optional source country group, GDP defaults G20
cli.limit: optional positive snapshot row count, default all group members

dataContract.rows: snapshot fields and source country identity; missing values remain null
dataContract.series: original source observations including t, v and macro_observation_period; no display downsampling
dataContract.units: percent numbers are already percent, USD raw amounts
dataContract.source: endpoints and fetchedAt; retrieval time is not observation period

agentContract.output: JSON, not a chart/table artifact. Choose generic visualization or text based on the request. No fixed style, chart type, top-six cutoff or mandatory layout. Reuse the successful data file downstream; do not fetch again merely to render.
